1 Project Posts Must Include Details When posting a project, please provide details which readers can use to gain value from your post besides the project itself. Examples include explaining the problem it solves or needs it addresses, technologies used, resources (ie. GitHub, blog posts, etc.)

2 No Spam or Excessive Self-Promotion Valuable posts are appreciated, blatant advertisements are not. Please refrain from posting the same project without significant updates from your last post, refrain from posting affiliate links, and engage with the community beyond just promoting your work.
3 Feedback Must Be Constructive When providing feedback, be respectful and helpful. Remember the person. Provide specific, actionable feedback and refrain from personal attacks or harassment.

4 No Funnelling Refrain from "funnelling posts" which serve to either openly or slyly get people to DM you asking for more information. This is an open community, and as such any value your post provides should be wholly contained within the post.

5 No Astroturfing It's important to be transparent about your relationship to any project you post, if you are caught astroturfing both you and your project will be permanently removed from the community.

6 Flair Appropriately Please select the appropriate flair that matches your post. If you are showcasing a project, use the "showcase" flairs, and if you vibe-coded the project, use the "vibecoded showcase" flairs.
